check_state.note: page untouched, a frame is free: the longest way through

cot_read.note: copy 32 B, test the valid flag

cpl_read.note: 16 B out of the ring, tag compare, head, one register store

desc_compress.note: new tag, 48 B descriptor with 7 chunk numbers

desc_decompress.note: new tag, 48 B descriptor from the COT entry

frame_write.note: memcpy of 4096 B as the C library does it

lock.note: atomic exchange, nobody else holds it

note_fresh.note: protect = 1, the thread had an older page on its list

note_hw.note: the job was answered and the answer was right

pick_victim.16_accessed.note: the hand passes 16 accessed pages first and clears their accessed flag

pick_victim.16_free.note: the hand passes 16 free frames first

pick_victim.16_fresh.note: the hand passes 16 fresh pages first

pick_victim.16_incompressible.note: the hand passes 16 incompressible RW pages first

pick_victim.ro_first.note: the first frame the hand meets can go, RO page

pick_victim.rw_first.note: the first frame the hand meets can go, RW page

reserve.11_words.note: 7 chunks, 9 all-ones words between words with 7 free bits: 11 words a call

reserve.2_words.note: 7 chunks, every word has 7 free bits: 2 words a call

reserve.7_words.note: 7 chunks, one free bit a word: 7 words a call

reserve.empty_pool.note: 7 chunks, all bits free: 1.11 words a call

submit.note: 48 B into the ring slot, tail, one register store

zero_frame.note: memset of 4096 B as the C library does it (DC ZVA, 64 B a step)
